The curriculum: Aligns with the National and State Educational Policies (NEP and SEP), incorporating industry-relevant concepts. Includes electives and skill enhancement courses, enabling students to tailor their learning to market trends. Employs a structured assessment system combining Continuous Internal Evaluation (CIE) and Semester End Examination (SEE) to ensure a well-rounded evaluation process Vision To be a leading institution in commerce, empowering students with practical knowledge, ethical values and global perspectives so they succeed in diverse sectors. Mission The Department of Commerce at SSMRV aims to provide quality education in a dynamic and inclusive environment, focusing on sustainability and continuous improvement.
